title: Align Q6 correctness with latest script (mark both Ronaldo and You as correct)

requirements.text: Update Quiz Question 6 ("Which thing do I love the most?") so that BOTH options "Ronaldo" and "You" are marked as correct answers (multi-correct), matching the latest provided quiz script, and ensure scoring/celebration behavior treats selecting either correct option as a correct answer.

quotes:
Q6. Which thing do I love the most?

Options

A. Myself 

B. Ronaldo✅

C. You✅

D. Food

acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/src/features/quiz/quizData.ts, Q6 option "Ronaldo" has isCorrect: true and option "You" has isCorrect: true (while "Myself" and "Food" remain isCorrect: false).
Selecting "Ronaldo" on Q6 increments the score by 1 and triggers the correct-answer celebration effects.
Selecting "You" on Q6 increments the score by 1 and triggers the correct-answer celebration effects.
Selecting "Myself" or "Food" on Q6 does not increment the score and does not trigger the correct-answer celebration effects.
Overall quiz total remains 7 questions; score display and result branching continue to use /7 scoring.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*.
Keep backend as a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; no new backend services.
Do not fetch images via the backend; continue using static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated for result memes.
No login should be required to complete the full experience; sharing must continue to copy the current app URL.
nonGoals: Adding or changing any quiz questions beyond Q6 correctness.
Changing the UI theme, screen flow, audio behavior, or share behavior (already implemented).
Introducing backend persistence, databases, or authentication beyond existing no-login flow.
